It hasn't been bestowed in thousands of years.|Master [[Jaric Kaedan]] recalls the second Barsen'thor, while awarding the title to the third one|audio=TheresaTitle.flac|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />}}
A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] individual lived [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Jedi, who showed exceptional skill and wisdom, was the second person in the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be granted the prestigious title of "'''Barsen'thor'''," a [[Cerean (language)|Cerean]] word for "[[Barsen'thor|Warden of the Order]]."

==Biography==
[[File:Jedi_symbol.svg|thumb|left|200px|The Barsen'thor served the Jedi Order.]]
[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the conflict known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]&mdash;which was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]&mdash;a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual was found by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. At some point in the Jedi's career, the individual was recognized by the Jedi Order for exceptional accomplishments by being granted the honorific title of "[[Barsen'thor]]," which translated to "Warden of the Order"<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> from the [[Cerean (language)|Cerean language]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Up until that point, the title had been used only once in the entire history of the Order, when it was [[Death/Legends|posthumously]] bestowed upon the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Lorjan Sakku]], in memory of him sacrificing his life to protect his fellow Jedi from his insane brother [[Lyhesh Sakku|Lyhesh]].<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />

By awarding that title to the second Barsen'thor, the Jedi Order acknowledged the individual as possessing great wisdom and skill,<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> comparable to Sakku's.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" /> After the second Barsen'thor's tenure, it would be thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until that ceremonial rank would be used again, when it was granted during the Cold War to a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who [[Duel on Vivicar's ship|prevented]] the [[Dark Plague crisis|near-eradication]] of the Jedi Order by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-[[Terrak Morrhage|engineered]] disease called the [[Dark Plague]].<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />

==Behind the scenes==
The second Barsen'thor was indirectly mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. During the course of the story, one of the game's playable character classes, the [[Jedi Consular]], attains the title of Barsen'thor, and it is stated that<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> he<ref name="Force and Destiny">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> is the third person in the history of the Jedi Order to have been granted that title, and it has been thousands of years since the last recipient&mdash;the second Barsen'thor.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />
